premises.scope: invertible indefinite ORIGINAL physical pair plus exact Schur residual with 1/4-Hoelder small-ball

premises.statement: one aggregate original star is guaranteed, but a second independent physical-gradient area is not yet guaranteed.

new_results.statement: For R=X^T B X+X^T(2MY+beta)+S(Y), where X consists of two original independent cap-one coordinates, Y is a disjoint original-product bank, B and S are arbitrary, and Delta2=sqrt(det(MM^T))>0, sup_z P(|R-z|<=eps)<=12(2Delta2)^(-1/3)eps^(2/3).
The preceding 2/3 small-ball bound implies sup_z E|R-z|^(-1/2)<21.687 Delta2^(-1/4).
After exact completion of a disjoint original scalar pivot d, if the Schur remainder has the two-gradient structure then ||p_Q||inf<21.687 |d|^(-1/2)Delta2^(-1/4); |d|,Delta2>=1/64 gives <491.

For an outer disjoint invertible indefinite original pair with D=|det B0| and kappa=sigma_min(B0), if the exact Schur residual has the two-gradient structure then ||p_Q||inf<13.281 D^(-1/3)kappa^(-1/6)Delta2^(-1/12); D,kappa,Delta2>=1/64 gives <151.

partner_application.actual_inequality: For e^-8<=D_res<=1, 34*sqrt(log(e/D_res))<102 in its residual-diffuse exact-null-coloop scope; no scope enlargement.

next_step: In the exact-rank-three small-Pluecker collar, prove either a quantitative two-row original-coordinate Schur cross-area lower bound and invoke the new receiver, or show that failure of every such area forces the already-paid exact-coloop/rank-one-bank geometry. Separately continue arbitrary-extra-spectrum assembly outside the new pair-plus-two-gradient branch.
